equation_summary: TPA factorizes the QKV projections via a CP decomposition (CPLinear): A_q=W_A_q(x) [.,H,q_rank], B_q=W_B_q(x) [.,q_rank,head_dim], then q=bmm(A_q,B_q)/q_rank (likewise k,v with rank). RoPE is applied to the B_q/B_k factors. The MIXER itself is plain causal softmax attention: y = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q,k,v,is_causal=True). The factorized A/B representation is what enables a factorized (low-rank) KV cache — the expanded per-head K/V need not be materialized for caching.
